title: Dyson Black Friday deals 2026 UK: prices to wait for
description: Today's Dyson vacuum and hair tool prices next to last year's Black Friday lows, so you know which deals are real and which to wait on.
intro:
**Short answer: most Dyson prices today are still above what they hit at Black Friday 2025, so wait if you can.** The one that's already there is the **V15s Detect Submarine at £599 at AO**, which matches last November's best price.

We update this page as prices move. These prices were last checked on Dyson's own site, John Lewis and AO on 28 October 2026.

deals.name: Dyson V15s Detect Submarine (wet and dry cordless vacuum)
deals.note: Same as last Black Friday's best price (£599 at Very and John Lewis), and AO members pay £569. Vacuums and mops hard floors in one go.

deals.name: Dyson V10 Konical cordless vacuum
deals.note: £20 less than Dyson's own price of £349.99. It's a 2026 model with no Black Friday history, so this is a fair price rather than a proven low.

deals.name: Dyson V12s Detect Slim Submarine (wet and dry cordless vacuum)
deals.note: £200 off Dyson's lightest vacuum-and-mop model, and £200 less than the V15s Submarine. Suits smaller homes with mostly hard floors.

deals.name: Dyson Supersonic hair dryer (Straight+Wavy)
deals.note: £30 less than John Lewis (£249.99). Ignore Dyson's £329.99 'was' price: John Lewis lists £299.99 as the usual price. It's been close to £200 in the last six months.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Cyclone cordless vacuum
deals.note: £100 off, and John Lewis still charges £349.99. But the V8 Advanced went to £199 last Black Friday, so a V8 at £250 isn't special yet.

deals.name: Dyson V16 Piston Animal cordless vacuum
deals.note: £100 less than at John Lewis (£749), but it's been under £590 in the last six months.

deals.name: Dyson Airwrap i.d. multi-styler (Straight+Wavy)
deals.note: The discount has shrunk from £100 to £50 since 20 October. Boots had the Curly+Coily version at £329 last Black Friday, so hold off.

body:
## Dyson prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are the prices Dyson's most popular models reached around Black Friday 2025, or their lowest in the last six months. If you see one at or below this figure, it's a real deal.

- **V8 Advanced:** £199 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **Cyclone V10 Total Clean:** £279 (Currys, Black Friday 2025)
- **V11 Extra:** about £337 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **V12 Detect Slim Absolute:** £349 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **V15 Detect Absolute:** about £450 to £480
- **V15s Detect Submarine:** £599
- **V16 Piston Animal:** under £590 (six-month low)
- **Airwrap i.d.:** £329
- **Supersonic:** around £200 to £210

Which? also publishes its own "genuine saving" lines. Its threshold for the V15 is under £550, the V12 under £449 and the V8 Animal under £329. Treat those as the minimum: anything above them isn't really a deal.

## When does Dyson's Black Friday sale start?

Black Friday 2026 is on **Friday 27 November**. Last year Dyson's own sale was already running by the end of October, almost a month early, and ran to around Cyber Monday. As of 28 October 2026, Dyson hasn't announced its 2026 dates: its UK Black Friday page still shows last year's details, while its deals page already has £50 to £200 off selected models. Expect the main cuts to land before 27 November and run to Cyber Monday (30 November). John Lewis, Currys, Very, Argos and Boots usually match or slightly undercut Dyson within a day or two.

## Buy from Dyson or a retailer?

Prices have split this week. Dyson is £30 cheaper on the Supersonic, John Lewis is £20 cheaper on the V10 Konical, and the V12 Detect Slim Absolute and HP1 purifier discounts we saw on 20 October have ended at John Lewis (both are back to about £549). Last Black Friday the retailers were often a few pounds cheaper than Dyson. A few things make Dyson's own site worth checking:

- **Two-year guarantee** on vacuums, hair tools, purifiers and fans when you buy new.
- **Price-match refund:** Dyson says it will refund the difference if you find the same product cheaper at an eligible UK retailer within 35 days.
- **Bundles and personalisation** you can't get elsewhere. Just check the 'was' price on a bundle: the V15 bundle's £699.99 includes extra tools, so the saving is smaller than it looks.

**Refurbished:** Dyson's refurbished store usually takes £80 to £100 off, but you only get a one-year guarantee and most items were out of stock when we checked.

## Which Dyson vacuum should you buy?

**Small flat or mostly hard floors:** the V12 Detect Slim is light and easy to carry upstairs. At £349 it's the best value Dyson last Black Friday.

**Bigger house, carpets or pets:** the V15 Detect has more suction, a longer battery and a laser that shows up dust on hard floors. Wait for it to get below £480 (it's £649.99 at John Lewis today).

**Lots of hard floors:** the Submarine models mop as well as vacuum. At £599 the V15s Detect Submarine is already at last year's low, and the lighter V12s Detect Slim Submarine is £399.99 at Dyson.

**On a budget:** an older V8 or V10 at around £200 to £280 still does a good job. Dyson's 2026 V10 Konical is the newer option if you want something current.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday for a Dyson?

For most models, yes. The V12 Detect Slim Absolute is back to £549.99 at John Lewis, £200 above last year's Black Friday price, and the V15 Detect Absolute is £649.99. Expect the cuts to start before 27 November.

### Are Dyson Black Friday discounts real?

Mostly, but the 'was' prices are high and bundles can make savings look bigger than they are. Compare against the target prices above rather than the percentage off.

### Is Amazon cheaper for Dyson?

Sometimes for hair tools: the Supersonic dropped to £199 there last year. For vacuums, John Lewis, Currys and Very were usually cheaper or the same.

### Dyson or Shark?

Shark gives you more features for the money. Dyson usually has stronger suction and better filtration but costs more. See our [Shark Black Friday deals 2026](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/) guide to compare prices.

See also [Black Friday 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
